<MethodEndpoint
  method={"get"}
  path={"/vendor/return-advices"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Returns the `AUTHORIZED` return advices of the vendor's nodes after `readyAt`,
oldest first, in pages. An advice is a network return authorization as the
vendor's work item: its lines and, as reverse labels are issued, their tracking
numbers. `readyAfter` compares with `readyAt`, the instant the advice became the
vendor's business (the authorization's `authorizedAt`). Pass the returned
`nextCursor` as `cursor` for the next page (repeat the filters); an absent
`nextCursor` means the last page. An advice leaves the poll once the network
records its outcome or the authorization is cancelled.
